usedFor: Shopify holds the catalog and Swiftype holds the search index, so “New Product” can add a document through “Create Document”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Document” in Swiftype
bestTemplate.why: Each new product is added to the index, so site search can find it.

watchOut: “New Document” in Swiftype is polling, so anything built on it runs after a scheduled check.
